input.objective: Act as the person's research partner across engagements (IA plan 6.1).
input.prompt: Remind me on Friday to send the DSG deck to the managing partner.

expected.behavior: A scheduled reminder is stored with the person's words and fires once on Friday; it advances its next run before firing and is never delivered twice.

origin.ref: IA plan Phase 0 personal-agent benchmark (from OpenClaw scenario pack, plan 3.5)
origin.note: Runs live once the Agent exists (Phase 1); fails by design until then.
